quest.title: A Mysterious Missive on Paper Wings
quest.description: It appears that Master Jean needs assistance with something. Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters and see what it is!
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters
Talk with everyone in the Knights of Favonius

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jean! We're here!

dialogues.speaker: Jean
dialogues.text: Ah, Paimon and the Traveler. I've been waiting for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, looks like Jean wasn't the only one waiting for us. Klee and Kaeya are here, too...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's Paimon and {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight! It's been so long!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Ah, look who it is.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: You've caught me completely off guard this time... But then again, it's always a pleasant surprise when you two show up.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, guess we were so excited to see Jean again that we forgot to knock. Hope we didn't startle anyone...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a sec, you weren't talking about anything that we're not supposed to hear, were you?

choices.text: Oh, so no one here ordered Good Hunter? Sorry, we must have the wrong address...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Stop pretending like we're doing food deliveries!

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: It's been a while since we last met, but I can see you two haven't changed one bit.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Don't worry. We weren't discussing anything confidential.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: In fact, we were just talking about you...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Maybe we should let the star of the story explain it in their own words?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! Lemme tell it, lemme tell it!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: A few days ago, I was reading Dodoco Tales in the solitary confinement room... when all of a sudden, whoosh! A letter came flying in through the window!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Flying through the window? How does a letter fly?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Like a bird does — it was flapping its wings. It could even talk!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It said... Um, well, it was a bunch of stuff I didn't understand...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You couldn't understand? Then it must have been talking about how to avoid solitary confinement...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Ahem, Kaeya...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Just saying... We don't want to let a teachable moment slip by.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: *sigh* Okay, I know... Anyway, the letter said: "Oh Klee, are you behaving? I see you've wound up in the solitary confinement room again..." Hehe, um, sorry about that.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: "Mommy is busy these days and can't take you out to play. But there's good news — I have a friend who has very kindly invited you to visit her!"

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, so the letter's from Alice!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That sounds great, doesn't it?

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: In principle, yes. But the issue is that Alice's friend lives quite far from here.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mm-hmm, the letter says that Mom's friend lives in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: The Knights of Favonius could never agree to send Klee off to Sumeru on her own, but Klee is rather intent on taking Alice's friend up on this invitation.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah! I really wanna go!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: You see? So, we were wondering — who can we send with her on the journey? Preferably, someone who's a reliable hero, and with a history of saving Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! So that's why you wanted to see us.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I do apologize, but Klee gets along with you so well... We couldn't think of a more suitable choice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, we can do that, no problem! Right?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Hehe, can you really, {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Yay!!! With {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight around, Klee's not afraid of anything!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #See, I told you that {F#she}{M#he}'d agree. In that case, we'll leave Klee in the trusty hands of {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: And you too, Kaeya... You should join them.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: I noticed you quietly completed that backlog of paperwork we had... You deserve the chance to unwind a little.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oh, so you noticed? Well then, I suppose I have no reason to refuse.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! Things'll go even more smoothly with Kaeya around. Still, Sumeru is pretty far... it's gonna be a long journey.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Don't worry! Mom's letter had a "Magic Invite" inside!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mom says we just have to all shout out where we want to go at the same time, and poof! We'll be there in the blink of an eye.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, well that'll definitely make things easier!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: It only works three times though. So we should only use it when we really need to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Three's plenty. One for the way there, one for the way back, and one extra, just for good measure.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Sounds very mysterious... I still think we should use it sparingly.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: After all, we don't know the exact location of where we'll be headed, or what dangers we may encounter on the way...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: #Here's what I suggest. {NICKNAME}, you're well-connected — I'm sure you must have friends who are familiar with Sumeru? I say we start by teleporting to one of them.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: It'll give us a chance to test out the "Magic Invite" and also find ourselves a local guide.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, that kinda makes sense... And since it has three uses, there's no point letting one of them go to waste.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Couldn't have put it better myself, Paimon. So, do you have a particular contact in mind?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe... Well, we need someone who's familiar with Sumeru and can be our guide, so... Sounds like we need a Forest Ranger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And everyone knows that the best place to go looking for a Forest Ranger is a little place called...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gandharva Ville.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the one! Maybe we can get Tighnari to help us!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Alright. Gandharva Ville it is.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: #Okay! I'm happy wherever we go! Especially with Kaeya and {F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: We should be on our way, then. If you'll excuse us, Acting Grand Master.

response.speaker: Jean
response.text: Yes, let the wind lead. I wish you a safe journey, and Klee...

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I know, I know... I'll be careful, I promise.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Great! Okay, here goes nothing: Take us to...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Gandharva Ville!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Gandharva Ville.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gandharva Ville.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Grand Arbor Hill!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh!? No, it's not a hill! Ah, wait!!!

choices.text: I was just showing Paimon the way — I'll leave you to it now...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hah! Showing your guide the way? Yeah, right.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, we made it. Paimon was sure we were about to end up some place super weird.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hehe, sorry! It was an accident...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's okay, Klee. Good news is, this Magic Invite really does work!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Fascinating. One moment we're in Mondstadt, the next we're in Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: So this is where Mom's friend lives? Wow, there are so many big flowers! Oh, and jumpy mushrooms!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You ain't seen nothin' yet! Sumeru's full of strange stuff like this!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Like, um...

choices.text: Boars with mushrooms growing on them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah! Heh, Paimon was pretty creeped-out the first time we saw one of those!

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Listen carefully, Klee. Those jumping mushrooms are called Fungi. They may look cute, but if you get too close to one, it'll try to hit you with its cap.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Really? Okay, well... I'll hit it back with my cap!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: And then I'll hit it with the hood on my jacket, too! Hee-hee, I'll definitely win if it's two hats against one!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yeah Klee, you show 'em!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: As long as playing with hats doesn't escalate to playing with bombs... But Klee's our friend, so we should be able to convince her to keep this trip explosion-free, right?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Mm-hmm! I'll be extra careful not to blow anything up! Um... I mean, I'll try my best...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aww, that's very good of you, Klee! You're being very grown-up today!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yep! I'm super grown-up, I'm already the Spark Knight!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, Spark Knight! Well, keep up the good work, 'cause very soon we'll be introducing you to a friend of ours called Tighnari in Gandharva Ville!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Paimon doesn't remember seeing one of those... Wait, are you talking about Paimon!?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Hmm, I've definitely heard the other Forest Rangers mention somebody dressed like that before...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I see. Then it looks like my suspicions are correct... Hmm? Who do we have here?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon! Oh, Kaeya and Klee are here, too!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Hi Collei, it's been aaages!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Collei, Eula! What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that question's really more for Eula.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: What a coincidence. I didn't expect to run into a fellow Favonian captain this far from Mondstadt. How's the vacation going?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Seriously? Bring the whole crew, why don't you? Tsk...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or does Eula not look particularly thrilled right now...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Oh, cool! Great idea! Let's go.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If you're trying to accommodate me, there must be some misunderstanding. I'm fine. There's nothing embarrassing about running into colleagues in the wild.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Uh, but earlier you were...

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Great! Well, I'm sure there's a fascinating reason behind why you're all the way out here in Sumeru. Do share it with us.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (Kaeya sure looks like he's getting a kick out of this...)

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: If you must know, it's a little complicated... But simply put, I'm searching for a cousin of mine from the Lawrence Clan.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: He went missing recently, and after searching his home, we found evidence that led us here. He appears to believe that somewhere in Sumeru lies the key to restoring our clan to its former glory.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He came all the way to Sumeru for that? What was he going to do, enroll at the Akademiya?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That would be quite a roundabout way to achieve his goals.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: I doubt he came here to learn. He's much too old to start getting a basic education now, and from what I know of him, I doubt he has any interest in intellectual pursuits.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: All he cares about is restoring his clan's honor. Nothing wrong with that idea in principle, but I'm not certain how fanatical he is about it. So there's no knowing what lengths he might go to.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: As a knight and a member of the Lawrence Clan, it's my duty to make sure he doesn't bring harm to others.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: Oho... If this is true, then your cousin is quite a man of action. Traveling alone to Sumeru from Mondstadt is no mean feat.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Nor is daring to make me personally concerned about his safety. Hmph, he has no idea what's coming to him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You know, underneath it all, Paimon thinks Eula's a really caring person.

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Yeah, she's the best! She brought me some Moon Pie last time!

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Ahem! He is family, after all... Anyway, I will make sure to find him and escort him safely back to Mondstadt.

choices.text: You're really going the extra mile for him.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Hm. Now, back to you... How and why did you all suddenly show up here?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain the situation to Eula and Collei...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Hmm, I'm afraid that could be tricky... Master Tighnari is still at Pardis Dhyai delivering his lectures. He isn't due back for a while...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: But I think I'll be able to help out. The description in the invitation letter is vague, but I'm pretty sure it's hinting at somewhere in the desert...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: The desert?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: Eh? Does that mean Mom's friend is from the desert? Hmm... I guess I'll call her Aunty Desert for now...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I remember Mahamatra Cyno once told me a strange rumor about that part of the desert...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: They say there's a secret domain there that can make all of your wishes come true...

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Ah, wait wait... He said I should just call him "Cyno." I keep forgetting that...

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: Huh. A domain that makes people's wishes come true...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, so is it true? Does it really exist?

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: I probably would have believed it a few years ago. But now that I'm a little older and wiser, I think it makes sense to be more skeptical about things like this.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: This explains a lot... The domain could well be a myth, but he probably figured he had nothing to lose. If you intend to search for this place, then please allow me to join you.

response.speaker: Eula
response.text: My cousin has quite a collection of books about Sumeru desert mythology on his shelves. I highly suspect that he, too, is looking for that domain.

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: Can I come, too? I—I think you might need me there!

response.speaker: Collei
response.text: You'll definitely need a local guide while you're in Sumeru, and... I think I have what it takes to be that person! Plus, it's a Forest Ranger's duty to bravely lend a helping hand to others in need.

response.speaker: Kaeya
response.text: We have every confidence in your abilities, Collei. Our party grows bigger and stronger still... What say you to this, Captain Klee?

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I think it's suuuuper cool!

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: I read in a story book that "On your own you only have a drop of happiness, but in a group you have a whole ocean."

response.speaker: Klee
response.text: So I'm sure Mom's friend will be super happy if I show up to visit and bring a whole bunch of friends with me!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's the spirit! In that case, let's get the Magic Invite to take us there!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Klee takes out the Magic Invite, and everyone says the destination out loud...

choices.text: He'll owe you one after this.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Whoa, this desert is huuuge!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Wow, what an incredible sight...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Yes, the scenery is quite magnificent.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Are you okay, Eula? You don't look so good...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: I'm fine, just taking a moment to acclimatize... The air here is much drier than in Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmm, this area doesn't look very habitable, and... I don't see a domain entrance nearby, either.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh no... I—I didn't pronounce the destination wrong, did I? I mean, I don't THINK I did...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Nope, you got it right! It definitely wasn't your fault!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: I said "Gandharva Ville" wrong earlier, but we still ended up in the right place!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Klee's right. We're in the right place, there's no doubt about that.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Phew...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe the entrance is hidden under a sand dune?

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: ...Who knows. We'll just have to start by looking around.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The party splits up to search the area, but turns up empty-handed...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sooo tired... and so thirsty...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hmm. We should have found something by now. Unless there's a problem with the Magic Invite?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Huh? How could that happen?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Uh-oh, did I break it by accident? But I didn't do anything! Dodoco will back me up, I'm innocent!

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: It's definitely not your fault, Klee! See? Not even a wrinkle on it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: If the domain is somewhere nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Does {M#Mr.}{F#Miss} Honorary Knight have an idea?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Instead of us trying to find the domain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ah, Paimon knows where you're going with this!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes. We can try getting the domain to find us.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Interesting approach. Assuming we're right about this Magic Invite...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: That is to say, if it was sent from within the domain, the invite likely has some sort of connection to it.

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it now! Plus, I know a super special trick we can use!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: What kind of trick? Can you teach it to us too?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Of course! Mom said that if I ever need help, I just need to shout this out loud:

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Magic Invite, Magic Invite, Klee needs your aid! Do something now, so Klee's not afraid!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Look, {NICKNAME}! Something flew over!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Hmm? It looks like... a bottle?

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Remarkably effective... That's one trick I'll be keeping up my sleeve in the future. You should make a note of it too, Eula.

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Absolutely not! It's not my style.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: I suppose bottles are pretty common in Sumeru mythology... So, is this supposed to be the entrance to the domain?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A domain in a bottle, huh... Well, if there's one thing we learned in Liyue, it's never judge a domain by its cover.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess there's one way to find out if this is really the way in! Come on, reach out with your hand!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Touch the bottle...)

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Look, look! There's a huge garden here!

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Incredible... It looked so small from the outside...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: Everyone, I suggest that we stop here for a moment. We should take stock of our surroundings before deciding on our next course of action.

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Since we're in a bottle... Has anyone here heard the story of the "magic bottle"?

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Oh, you mean the one about King Deshret and the Jinni-in-a-bottle? I've read it before, but I struggled with some of the vocabulary...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: What's the story about, Kaeya?

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Mom told me a story once about a group of adventurers who went to Bottleland... But I don't think there was a magic bottle in that one...

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Klee, I can tell you all about the story of the magic bottle. But if you keep running off on your own, you'll miss all the good parts...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Oh... Okay, I got it. I'll stay with the group from now on...

dialogues.speaker: Eula
dialogues.text: You sense it too, don't you Collei? Something's not quite right.

dialogues.speaker: Collei
dialogues.text: Yeah... The scenery here is beautiful, but it's too quiet. And there's no sign of Klee's "Aunty Desert" here anywhere...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Maybe Aunty Desert lives way further down inside? This place is suuuuper big, just like Fischl's Immernachtreich. We still have a long way to go!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess we won't know until we get there. Let's keep going.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hopefully we'll meet her soon!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look! It's Collei! Huh, and is that Eula with her? What's she doing in Gandharva Ville?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We made it! That answers that question...

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: There's a path. I'm gonna take a look!

dialogues.speaker: Kaeya
dialogues.text: Hey, don't run off and leave us all behind.
